description: Hermes (hAT family, Musca domestica); 8-bp target-site duplication, weak nTnnnnAn target preference.

splinkerette_pcr.description: Reads start inside the Hermes end and run into the genome (e.g. ...TTGAAGTTCTCTG|genome). Terminal Hermes and adaptor sequence is detected and trimmed automatically from primers.json and the Hermes reference.

terminal_10bp.description: Short reads that begin with only the last 10 bp of the Hermes end (AAGTTCTCTG|genome) and may end in the ligated adapter (GTCCCTTAAGCGGAG). The end is trimmed when anchored at the read start; reads without it are discarded; the adapter and Illumina read-through are trimmed from the 3' end.
used_by: Guo et al. 2013 (S. pombe, SRR327340; 50-bp Genome Analyzer II reads)

end_ligated_adapter.description: Reads start inside the Hermes end (...TTGAAGTTCTCTG), continue into the genome and end in a ligated adapter (GTCCCTTAAGCGGAG, then a short tag and Illumina adaptor). The Hermes end is trimmed wherever it occurs; reads without it are discarded; the adapter and Illumina read-through are trimmed from the 3' end.
